name: io.github.d3ltasecurity/opnsense-guard-mcp
title: OPNsense Guard
description: Safety-first OPNsense firewall MCP: read-only by default, planned and auto-reverting writes.

environmentVariables.name: OPNSENSE_API_KEY

environmentVariables.name: OPNSENSE_CA_BUNDLE
environmentVariables.description: CA file for a self-signed firewall certificate
